2026-11-10: World 1 = fw-t10 at Cherry Reach, World 2 = fw-s10 at Twin Banks; new worlds wait for the new building styles

ready_when: every field under `open` is answered and the day-0 snapshot exists

host.why: retired since September, no players, already runs Paper 1.21.8 build 60 (the showcase's build) as a service; the large node has about 131 GB RAM free at 33% CPU
host.now: 6 vCPU, 12 GB, 100 GB disk (93 GB free)
host.wanted: 12 vCPU, 24 GB: the showcase VM carries Paper and 14 bots at a load of 4-7 with about 9 GB in use
host.old_world: its August testbed world stays where it is, never deleted; the rehearsal is a new level name beside it
host.not_chosen: mc-playground: its node is full and carries the house's firewall and DNS. vm-minecraft-ai and vm-minecraft-bots: the instance-1 pair retired 08-21, no guest agent, older images

site.known_difficulty: 32% tree cover (old-growth birch and dark forest): heavy felling before any plot is clear
site.source: the 2026-11-10 seed screen (seeds.md, site table); chosen offline from a seed copy, as the owner approved on 11-06

code.sha_rule: the showcase release that is live when the run starts; rehearsal 0 does not wait for the one-trunk merge
code.flags_rule: a copy of the showcase's settings taken at the start, kept beside this manifest's run record with its sha256

bots.brain: the same model endpoint the showcase uses at the start; name it and its model here before the run

rules.admin_edits: none: no teleport, no give, no setblock or fill, no world-file edits
rules.owner_one_off_repairs: each one is an assistance entry and marks the run assisted
rules.code_changes: allowed in a rehearsal; each one is logged with its sha and the run restarts from the day-0 snapshot
rules.restart_rule: a restart is a new run id (rehearsal-1, rehearsal-2, ...) with its own manifest copied from this one
rules.finish_line_runs_differ: 7 days, code frozen, any code change or admin edit restarts the 7-day clock

criteria.measure: bots within 64 blocks of the site centre / bots
criteria.pass: all, within 2 h of the start

criteria.measure: completed house, cottage or hall plots that still stand when re-read
a completed storehouse, storehub or shopchest
